blocks.text: EL SEGUNDO, California — Luka Doncic has been a leader and a star ever since he was a teenager at Real Madrid, so his new role this fall as the clear focal point of the Los Angeles Lakers is nothing new. Yet Doncic is still eager to take on the biggest responsibility of his basketball career to date in the wake of LeBron James’ decision to leave LA. “It’s like a new challenge. I like challenges,” Doncic said Monday when the Lakers reported to training camp for media day. “I wouldn’t say I feel different, but I would say I feel […]...
